Notes: MACPAC 2022 standard for general nursing facilities

Standard_Text: Except during night hours, when 20 or fewer residents are present, at least two direct care staff members shall be awake and on duty at all times in each special care unit who shall be responsible for the care and supervision of the residents. For every additional 10 residents, or portion thereof, at least one more direct care staff member shall be awake and on duty in the unit.
Notes: Virginia Administrative Code 22VAC40-73-1130 - Staffing requirements for special care units
Applies_To: Assisted Living Facilities - Special Care Units
